rows.name: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for South Dakota's wildlife, fisheries, and state parks. Eight members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent, balanced east/west-river and by party (SDCL 41-2-1).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the South Dakota Codified Laws; SD publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: South Dakota Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: South Dakota home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates South Dakota's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor — three active brokers and two public members (SDCL 36-21A-13).
